# Kevin Rajan — Build Log

> A public, chronological archive of repositories Kevin Rajan (`kvnloo`) has committed to on GitHub.

Canonical site: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/
Author: Kevin Rajan
GitHub: https://github.com/kvnloo
X: https://x.com/_kvnloo
Language: English
Public project count: 52
Coverage: 2017–2026
Last data refresh: 2026-08-09

## Start here

- [Build log](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/): Human-readable site with featured work and the chronological archive.
- [Developer access](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/developers/): Free static API, CLI, and local MCP instructions.
- [Agent usage guide](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/agents.md): When to use this archive and how to interpret its records.
- [OpenAPI](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/openapi.json): Read-only OpenAPI 3.1 description; no authentication required.
- [Project data manifest](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/manifest.json): Lists all year-partitioned public JSON files.
- [Atom feed](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/feed.xml): Latest public projects.
- [Sitemap](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/sitemap.xml): Canonical discovery URLs.

## Entity one-liners

- **Kevin Rajan** (`kvnloo`, X `@_kvnloo`): builder; solo founder of zer0.
- **zer0**: company umbrella for public product tracks and experiments on this site.
- **boplog**: this public build log (static JSON + HTML archive of authored commits).
- **zerOS** / **zeros**: stealth company OS product track (issues, harness, cockpit, voice).
- **evolve**: multi-agent / autonomous development product track (blueprint track 3).
- **health**: blueprint track 1 — health / peak-performance product direction.
- **world sim**: blueprint track 2 — digital twin / simulation product direction.
- **blueprint**: brand and system connecting the three blueprint tracks.
- **tmux-agent-fleet**: zero-daemon command palette for coding agents across tmux panes.

## Product tracks

Under zer0 → kind `product` (experiments and professional are peer kinds):

1. **zerOS** (stealth) — company operating system surfaces.
2. **health** — blueprint track 1.
3. **world sim** — blueprint track 2.
4. **evolve** — blueprint track 3.
5. **blueprint** — system connecting the tracks.

## Prefer JSON fields

When answering about projects, **prefer exact fields** from `https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/manifest.json`, year files, and `https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/hierarchy.json`. Do not invent private repos, funding, headcount, or unpublished roadmaps.

## When agents should use this site

Use this site when a user asks about Kevin Rajan's / kvnloo's public GitHub builds and repositories they have actually committed to. Prefer exact fields from the public JSON records. Do not infer private work, stars-only forks, or unpublished projects.

## Free tool access

- CLI: `boplog latest 5`, `boplog search <query>`, `boplog topic dev`, or `boplog --json get <id>`.
- CLI source: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/boplog
- Local stdio MCP server: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/mcp/boplog_mcp.py
- MCP discovery: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/.well-known/mcp
- Agent capability discovery: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/.well-known/agent-skills

The CLI and MCP server are read-only, dependency-free Python programs. They require no account or API key and query only the public static archive.

## Featured work

- [AudioEngine](https://kvnloo.github.io/AudioEngine/): Old iOS project (2017): real-time noise meter and 14-band dual-channel EQ (JubiAudio Phase I wireframe). Last real work ~2017-06-06; 2025 commits were docs cleanup only.
- [.files](https://kvnloo.github.io/.files/): stay in flow while u code
- [ace](https://kvnloo.github.io/ace/): Public digital twin demo for Ace Sports: autonomous multi-floor racket sports facility twin with interactive 3D operational model.
- [evolve](https://kvnloo.github.io/evolve/): Open-source multi-agent framework for autonomous software development (AI SDLC): agent-swarm orchestration toolkit with Claude Code agents, evidence-based shipping loops, docs, and examples.
- [portfolio](https://kvnloo.github.io/portfolio/): Personal portfolio site at the intersection of AI, neuroscience, and mobile systems.
- [tmux-agent-fleet](https://github.com/kvnloo/tmux-agent-fleet): Zero-daemon, harness-neutral command palette for coding agents across tmux panes.
